heroCommands.comment: Clone and run locally with uv
heroCommands.command:
git clone https://github.com/sansan0/TrendRadar.git
cd TrendRadar
uv sync
uv run python -m trendradar

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: TrendRadar is a self-hosted news assistant. It collects trending topics from 11 Chinese platforms such as Weibo, Zhihu and Bilibili plus your RSS feeds, filters them by your keywords or with AI, and pushes a digest to WeChat Work, Telegram, Slack, email and other channels.
sixtySeconds.problem: Scrolling many trending lists to find the few stories you care about wastes time. TrendRadar watches them for you, keeps only matching news, and sends it to the apps you already use, with optional AI analysis and translation.
whoFor: Users who want a news digest in Telegram, Slack or WeChat
Self-hosters with a server, NAS or always-on PC
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a lightweight, quick-to-deploy news monitor that supports keyword or AI filtering and many push channels, deployable with Docker, GitHub Actions or locally.
requirements: Docker, or uv for local runs, or a GitHub account for Actions
A push channel (Telegram, Slack, email, WeChat Work and others)
An AI model API key only if you use the AI features

overview: By default TrendRadar monitors 11 platforms, including Zhihu, Douyin, Bilibili, Baidu, Weibo and Toutiao, and you can add custom platforms and RSS or Atom feeds. Trending data comes through the API of the newsnow project.

Filtering uses keywords in config/frequency_words.txt, or AI mode, where you describe your interests in plain language in ai_interests.txt and AI scores each story. AI features also include analysis reports and multi-language translation. Main settings live in config/config.yaml.

There are three ways to deploy: Docker (recommended, more stable), GitHub Actions created from the template (needs a check-in renewal every 7 days and cloud storage), or locally with uv. An MCP server is also available. The project is GPL-3.0 licensed, and its main README is in Chinese with an English version.
